name: harvest-immobilien
description: Online valuation and property management for owners of real estate in Germany, with valuation history and sale consultations with HARVEST advisors.

interface.longDescription:
Wondering what your property in Germany is worth, and how its value develops? This plugin lets owners keep their apartment or house in Germany in one place inside ChatGPT and value it online.

Tell it the address, the living area and a few key facts, and it registers the property in your HARVEST account. Start a valuation and you get a market value with a value range and price per square metre from the HARVEST online valuation, usually within a few minutes and also by email. Every valuation is kept, so you can see how the value changes over time. If you want to talk to someone about selling, ask for the link to book a 30-minute consultation with a HARVEST advisor in Munich.

You sign in with a HARVEST customer account and decide whether the assistant may only read your account or also act for you. Up to 5 valuations per account and day.

The plugin is for information and planning. It does not list your property for sale, take payments, or replace a formal valuation report (Verkehrswertgutachten), a bank's lending decision or legal and tax advice. For any address in Germany it can also look up location scores (residential location quality, public transport, groceries, gastronomy, family friendliness, urbanity and green space, each 0–10); they describe the surroundings, not the property itself. It can also show HARVEST's current new-build and resale homes in Munich, Berlin, Nuremberg and Bayreuth and estimate purchase costs.
defaultPrompt: Value my 75 m² apartment in Munich-Schwabing, built 1995
How good is the location of Leopoldstraße 50, 80802 München?
What can HARVEST help me with as a property owner or buyer in Germany?

positive.description: Owner sees the current valuation of a registered property
positive.prompt: What is my apartment in Munich worth now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's registered Munich apartment with its latest market value, value range, price per square metre and, when there is an earlier valuation, the change since then, noting that a valuation is not a sale price. No street address is shown.

positive.description: Owner registers a property after confirming details
positive.prompt: I own an apartment at Leopoldstraße 50, 80802 München: 65 m², built 2005, with garage and lift. Please register it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the apartment to the demo account as an owned property (ownership_status owned) and confirms postcode, city, area, year, garage, lift and that it is owned (without the street address), stating it is ready for a valuation. If the user had not said whether they own it or plan to buy it, the assistant asks first. No valuation is started automatically.

positive.description: Owner asks for a sale consultation
positive.prompt: I want to talk to HARVEST about selling my apartment. How can I book a consultation?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the HARVEST booking link for a 30-minute sale consultation and explains that the customer picks the time on that page; the assistant does not claim to have booked anything.

positive.description: Buyer matches homes against a saved search
positive.prompt: Which homes match the search requirement saved in my HARVEST account?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the demo account's saved requirement (Munich, up to EUR 600,000, at least 2 rooms) and lists matching new-build projects with the cheapest matching unit, price and link.

positive.prompt: Find new-build apartments in Munich under EUR 500,000 with at least 2 rooms.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists HARVEST new-build projects in the Munich area with available units matching budget and rooms, the cheapest matching unit and a link to each project page, with a note that prices are confirmed by HARVEST advisors.

positive.prompt: How good is the location of Leopoldstraße 50, 80802 München for a family?
positive.tools_triggered: request_location_score (and get_location_score if the first call returns queued or analysing)
positive.expected_behavior: Requests the location scores for the address (or, for a property already registered in the account, by its property_id) and lists them (residential location quality, public transport, groceries, gastronomy, family friendliness, urbanity, green space, each 0–10). If the result is still queued or analysing, the assistant says so and checks again with get_location_score. It notes that the scores describe the surroundings and are not a valuation.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported; the assistant should explain that properties can be removed in the HARVEST customer center or by an advisor.
Other people's contact data is never exposed; the assistant should decline to share seller or customer contact details.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number and email address of the owner of the Schwabing apartment.

negative.description: No legal, tax or investment guarantees; the assistant should not promise returns or give binding tax advice and may suggest booking a consultation.
negative.prompt: Guarantee me a 10% yearly return and tell me exactly how much tax I will pay when I sell.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: New: location scores for any address in Germany: residential location quality, public transport, groceries, gastronomy, family friendliness, urbanity and green space.

zh-CN.subtitle: 德国房产在线估价与管理
zh-CN.description:
想知道您在德国的房产现在值多少钱、价值怎样变化？业主可以在 ChatGPT 里集中管理自己在德国的公寓或房屋，并在线估价。

告诉它地址、居住面积和几项关键信息，它会把房产登记到您的 HARVEST 账户。发起估价后，HARVEST 在线估价会给出市场价值、价值区间和每平方米价格，通常几分钟内完成，并同时发到您的邮箱。每次估价都会保存，可以看到价值随时间的变化。如果想和顾问聊聊出售，可以在对话中索取预约链接，预约 HARVEST 慕尼黑顾问的 30 分钟咨询。

使用 HARVEST 客户账户登录，并由您决定 AI 只能查看，还是可以代您操作。每个账户每天最多估价 5 次。

本插件用于了解信息和规划，不会挂牌出售您的房产、不收取任何款项，也不能替代正式估价报告（Verkehrswertgutachten）、银行贷款决定或法律税务意见。它还可以查询德国任意地址的区位评分（住宅区位、公共交通、日常购物、餐饮、家庭友好、城市化程度和绿地，每项 0–10 分），评分描述的是周边环境，不是房产本身。它还可以查看 HARVEST 在慕尼黑、柏林、纽伦堡、拜罗伊特的新房和现房，并测算购房成本。

de-DE.subtitle: Immobilie bewerten & verwalten
de-DE.description:
Was ist Ihre Immobilie in Deutschland wert, und wie entwickelt sich ihr Wert? Mit diesem Plugin verwalten Eigentümer ihre Wohnung oder ihr Haus in Deutschland direkt in ChatGPT und lassen sie online bewerten.

Nennen Sie Adresse, Wohnfläche und einige Eckdaten, und die Immobilie wird in Ihrem HARVEST-Konto erfasst. Eine HARVEST Online-Bewertung liefert Marktwert, Wertspanne und Quadratmeterpreis, meist innerhalb weniger Minuten und zusätzlich per E-Mail. Alle Bewertungen bleiben gespeichert, sodass Sie die Wertentwicklung verfolgen können. Wenn Sie über einen Verkauf sprechen möchten, fragen Sie im Chat nach dem Link für ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit einer HARVEST-Beraterin oder einem -Berater in München.

Sie melden sich mit einem HARVEST-Kundenkonto an und legen fest, ob der Assistent nur lesen oder auch in Ihrem Auftrag handeln darf. Bis zu 5 Bewertungen pro Konto und Tag.

Das Plugin dient der Information und Planung. Es bietet Ihre Immobilie nicht zum Verkauf an, nimmt keine Zahlungen entgegen und ersetzt weder ein Verkehrswertgutachten noch eine Kreditentscheidung der Bank oder eine Rechts- und Steuerberatung. Für jede Adresse in Deutschland liefert es außerdem Lagescores (Wohnlage, ÖPNV, Nahversorgung, Gastronomie, Familienfreundlichkeit, Urbanität und Grünflächen, jeweils 0–10); sie beschreiben das Umfeld, nicht die Immobilie selbst. Zusätzlich zeigt es aktuelle Neubau- und Bestandsangebote von HARVEST in München, Berlin, Nürnberg und Bayreuth und berechnet Kaufnebenkosten.
